title: CAF-1 deposits newly synthesized histones during DNA replication using distinct mechanisms on the leading and lagging strands
authors: Rouillon C; Eckhardt BV; Kollenstart L; Gruss F; Verkennis AE; Rondeel I; Krijger PH; Ricci G; Biran A; van Laar T; Delvaux de Fenffe CM; Luppens G; Albanese P; Scheltema RA; de Laat W; Dekker NH; Groth A; Mattiroli F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CAF-1在DNA复制中组装组蛋白的机制，属于染色质复制生物学，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

During every cell cycle, both the genome and the associated chromatin must be accurately replicated. Chromatin Assembly Factor-1 (CAF-1) is a key regulator of chromatin replication, but how CAF-1 cooperates with the DNA replication machinery is unknown. Here, we reveal that this crosstalk differs between the leading and lagging strand at replication forks. Using biochemical reconstitution, we show that DNA and histones promote CAF-1 recruitment to its binding partner PCNA and reveal that two CAF-1 complexes are required for efficient nucleosome assembly under these conditions. Remarkably, in the context of the replisome, CAF-1 competes with the leading strand DNA polymerase epsilon (Polε) for PCNA binding, but not with the lagging strand DNA polymerase Delta (Polδ). Yet, in cells, CAF-1 deposits newly synthesized histones equally on both daughter strands. Thus, on the leading strand, chromatin assembly by CAF-1 cannot occur simultaneously to DNA synthesis, while on the lagging strand both processes are coupled. We propose that these differences may facilitate distinct parental histone recycling mechanisms and accommodate the inherent asymmetry of DNA replication.
abstract_zh:
摘要

在每个细胞周期中，基因组及其相关染色质都必须被精确复制。染色质组装因子-1（CAF-1）是染色质复制的关键调控因子，但CAF-1如何与DNA复制机制协同作用尚不清楚。在此，我们揭示这种相互作用在复制叉的前导链和后随链之间存在差异。通过生化重构，我们证明DNA和组蛋白促进CAF-1向其结合伙伴PCNA的招募，并揭示在这些条件下，两个CAF-1复合物是高效核小体组装所必需的。值得注意的是，在复制体环境中，CAF-1与前导链DNA聚合酶ε（Polε）竞争PCNA结合，但不与后随链DNA聚合酶δ（Polδ）竞争。然而，在细胞中，CAF-1将新合成的组蛋白均等地沉积到两条子链上。因此，在前导链上，CAF-1介导的染色质组装不能与DNA合成同时进行，而在后随链上，这两个过程是偶联的。我们提出这些差异可能促进不同的亲本组蛋白回收机制，并适应DNA复制固有的不对称性。
